Install grok-bot on Omarchy

Grok Bot is xAI's always-on AI agent product: each Bot you create gets a persistent cloud virtual machine with its own browser, filesystem, and terminal, and can sign into your tools and apps to carry out multi-step work, resuming after you close your device. You can watch a live screen-share of what a Bot is doing, and access the same Bot from desktop or mobile. It uses a permission-escalation model, starting read-only and gaining write/execute access as it proves reliable.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add grok-bot
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.78.1-1:
    pacman -Qi grok-bot

Open and use grok-bot

grok-bot is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql grok-bot | grep applications

Frequently asked questions

How do I install grok-bot on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add grok-bot. The download is 136.3 MB and it takes 403.7 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is grok-bot free?

Bundled into paid tiers such as SuperGrok Heavy ($300/mo), Cursor Ultra ($200/mo), or Cursor Teams Premium ($120/seat/mo); no free tier at launch. The package is licensed custom.

How do I uninstall grok-bot?

Run omarchy pkg drop grok-bot. It removes the package from your system.

What does grok-bot depend on?

The package declares 11 dependencies: alsa-lib, at-spi2-core, gtk3, hicolor-icon-theme, libnotify, libsecret, libxss, libxtst, nss, util-linux-libs, xdg-utils. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is grok-bot a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for grok-bot.

Is grok-bot in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as grok-bot (version 0.78.1-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. xAI makes it. Project site: https://x.ai/bot.
